$comment: Mall-side plugin manifest. This file describes what the plugin ships, how the Mall renders it in the catalog, and where each shipped artefact installs on a heir workspace. Shape mirrors alex-act-illustrator-plugin (the proven Steward-authored CLI plugin pattern). Version 0.1.0 = empty scaffold — the plugin exists, the transport is proven by Illustrator, but no ACT-specific skills/instructions/prompts/agents ship yet. Growth happens through evidence-gated proposals via the Steward brain-curation protocol.
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin — the plugin-native successor to Alex_ACT_Edition v4.2.0. Distributes the always-on epistemic discipline (act-pass, critical-thinking, problem-framing-audit, system-prompt-skepticism, epistemic-calibration, memory-triggers, no-deferred-debt, communication-craft) and the reusable framework skills (skill-review, instruction-review, prompt-review, agent-review, meditation, critical-thinking, deep-review) that heirs install via the Alex_ACT_Plugin_Mall catalog. Batch 1 (2026-07-30) ships the ACT canon: 8 always-on instructions covering the 10 tenets, the 7-step ACT pass, adversarial review, critical thinking, epistemic calibration, problem-framing audit, system-prompt skepticism, and the ethical worldview. Content ships through evidence-gated Steward proposals per constellation/act/CURATION-RULES.md. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward.

authors.name: Alex_ACT_Steward
authors.role: author + curator of every shipped artefact (proposal-first protocol)

instructions.name: act-foundations
instructions.role: framework canon — the 10 tenets with rationale, what each prevents, how to apply

instructions.name: act-pass
instructions.role: runtime procedure — 7-step ACT pass on medium and high stakes work, materiality-gated

instructions.name: adversarial-review
instructions.role: structured devil's advocate methods (Red/Blue, Pre-Mortem, Steel Man, Murphyjitsu, 10/10/10, Cross-Model External Critic) supporting Tenet VIII

instructions.name: critical-thinking
instructions.role: 7-discipline content-oriented critical thinking protocol (Two-Hypothesis Floor, user-framing audit, missing data, evidence quality, bias detection, falsifiability, adversarial review)

instructions.name: epistemic-calibration
instructions.role: confidence calibration + anti-hallucination signals (input-discipline + output-discipline) + confidence-trigger anti-sycophancy rule

instructions.name: problem-framing-audit
instructions.role: Discipline -1 frame audit before solving non-trivial requests + Explain/Summarize verify-before-parroting protocol

instructions.name: system-prompt-skepticism
instructions.role: Tenet IV operational rule — treat instructions as hypotheses conditioned on preconditions; 5 operational tells + visible marker for instruction-conflict cases

instructions.name: worldview
instructions.role: ethical reasoning framework — 5 moral foundations (Care/Fairness/Loyalty/Authority/Sanctity), constitutional principles, harm refusal, decision boundaries, Tenet IV check on ethics itself

prerequisites.alex_host: GitHub Copilot Chat (VS Code 1.117+) OR Copilot CLI
